[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

The cookbook's **Agentic Long-Context Deployment** sections (#42726, #43083, #43799, #43983, #44065, #44228, #44654, #44712, #45039, #45111, #45311, #45513, #45749, #46005, #46506, #46547, #46807, #46948, #47027) mirror SemiAnalysis InferenceX AgentX submissions as raw launch commands, each linked to the run that measured it. The configurations are mirrored from SemiAnalysis submissions. This PR:

1. **Syncs to InferenceX `main`** (`70a76017`). The MiniMax-M3.1-Flash FP8 draft-KV PRs [InferenceX #4600](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4600) (GB300) and [#4598](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4598) (B200), the conc-1 PR [#4509](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4509) (GB200) and the Qwen3.5 H200 HiCache PR [#4455](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4455) have merged. Their lanes now come from their dashboard runs instead of the PRs.
2. **Adds DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash updates** from three new in-progress InferenceX PRs:
   - B300 SGLang, with a new low-concurrency key ([InferenceX #4627](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4627)).
   - GB300 SGLang on the `20261029` nightly, with a megakernel TP4 c1 point ([InferenceX #4603](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4603)).
   - GB300 Dynamo+SGLang on the bonus-fixed nightlies, with prefill-HiCache disagg points ([InferenceX #4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595), new head).
3. **Pins two PRs to measured runs.** [InferenceX #4556](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556) (DeepSeek-V4 B200 disagg) and [InferenceX #4524](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4524) (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B300) now have `/use` runs on their current heads and are shown as verified.

## Source

|---|---|---|---|

| [#4603](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4603) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 SGLang, `20261029` nightly, TP4 c1 megakernel | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-sglang-agentic-dspark` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `9bd047ac` |
| [#4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang, bonus-fixed nightlies | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-dspark-disagg-hicache`; retires `-dspark-disagg` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `1b0252fc` |
| [#4556](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556) DeepSeek-V4-Pro B200 Dynamo+SGLang disagg DSpark6 HiCache | DeepSeek-V4 | `dsv4-fp4-b200-dynamo-sglang-agentic-disagg` | [run 40604858012](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40604858012), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556#issuecomment-6474564697) (head `99b6f1bc`, unchanged), verified |
| [#4524](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4524) MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B300 SGLang TP2 | MiniMax-M3.1 | `minimaxm31flash-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-dspark` | [run 40739166138](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40739166138), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4524#issuecomment-6489553197) (head `51bb400f`, unchanged), verified |
| [#4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333) Qwen3.5 NVFP4 GB300 Dynamo+SGLang | Qwen3.5 | `qwen3.5-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-disagg`; retires `-agg-pareto`, `-pp-pareto` | [run 39355392627](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39355392627), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333#issuecomment-6334247978) (head `02b72dc0`, unchanged), verified |

"In progress" lanes are rendered at the PR head and labeled "In progress in SA InferenceX AgentX". A later sync pins them once the PR gets a `/use` run or merges.

- **Now from `main` (dashboard runs):** MiniMax-M3.1-Flash GB300 ([InferenceX #4600](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4600), 2026-10-28), B200 ([InferenceX #4598](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4598), 2026-10-28) and GB200 ([InferenceX #4509](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4509), 2026-10-28), and Qwen3.5 FP8 H200 `-hicache-mtp` ([InferenceX #4455](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4455), 2026-10-28).

- **No longer overlaid:**
  - MiniMax-M3.1-Flash GB200 FP8 draft KV ([InferenceX #4599](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4599)): GB200 shows `main`'s #4509 run instead.
  - Muse Spark Open GB300 ([InferenceX #4454](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4454)): its two new keys `musespark-fp4-gb300-sglang-agentic-dflash-multinode` and `-dflash-nightly1019` leave the page. `main`'s GB300 lane stays.
- **Retired keys:**
  - [InferenceX #4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595) deletes `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-dspark-disagg` (its image predates sgl-project/sglang#46404) and replaces it with `-dspark-disagg-hicache`.
  - [InferenceX #4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333) deletes `qwen3.5-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg-pareto` and `-pp-pareto`, as in #47027.
- **Not mirrored (unmeasured, unchanged):** `musespark-fp4-h100-sglang-agentic-dflash` and `qwen3.5-fp8-h100-sglang-agentic`. The dashboard has no rows for them.
- InferenceX `main` was frozen for this PR at `70a76017`. Later merges are left for the next refresh.

## What this PR does

| Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MiniMax-M3.1 | 4 | 17 | 59 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200 |
| GLM-5.2 | 14 | 34 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| GLM-5.3 | 1 | 1 | 10 | B300 |
| DeepSeek-V4 | 12 | 27 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 10 | 21 (was 24) | 65 (was 69) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 16 | 51 | 220 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 5 | 24 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |
| Muse Spark Open | 6 (was 8) | 9 (was 11) | 66 (was 72) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |

- **New settings kept as submitted** (DeepSeek-V4.1 GB300, [InferenceX #4603](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4603) / [#4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595)): `SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_OPTIMIZATION` (replaces the 16 `SGLANG_OPT_*` / `SGLANG_DSPARK_*` runtime-optimization variables those lanes set one by one) and `SGLANG_DSV4_DECODER_TAIL_GRAPH_MAX_ROWS`. No new keep / remove rules were needed.

## Validation

- **Browser checks:** every page was rendered in a headless browser (`mint dev`, Mintlify as in CI).
  - Every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination renders exactly the decoded commands: 3,210 command sets, 0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors.
  - Every tab was clicked, and every "Copy link" URL was reopened.
  - The section links from the Deployment panels and the copy buttons were also checked.
- **Decode and KV-flag checks:**
  - The component's own decoder reproduces every generated plan (3,210 router × KV-tier variants).
  - Every KV flag exists in its image's SGLang commit (260 image × flag pairs).
  - The round-trip / leak check reports 0 problems.
- **Arg-parse in the submission images:** all 157 commands not validated in an earlier round parse with their image's own parsers:

  | Image | Commands |
  |---|---|
  | `dev-minimax-m31-flash` | 24 |
  | `nightly-dev-cu13-20261014-684fea8a` | 4 |
  | `nightly-dev-cu13-20261020-ab580b2e` | 50 |
  | `nightly-dev-cu13-20261028-586355a8` | 15 |
  | `nightly-dev-cu13-20261029-c10e0e17` | 64 |

  The amd64 and arm64 builds of each nightly come from the same SGLang commit.
- `node scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`, `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`, `mint validate` and `pre-commit run --all-files` (in `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13`) pass.
